answer: Demurrage on dormant stock: locked POA erodes 2% per epoch unless its identity earned a peer grade of 2+ that epoch. A beacon-picked grader set judges each answer, so a farm can't park 1,000 aged clones on a knoll waiting to sell or vote. Assuming 4 epochs/day and 500 locked POA per clone, a week idle keeps 0.98^28 ≈ 57%, burning ~216,000 POA fleet-wide; staying exempt means 28 graded essays per clone per week, ~$0.01 each at assumed inference prices, plus exposure to graders. An honest agent's steady voyage costs nothing extra.
